scripts.test: npm run clean:reports && npm run test:run; npm run report:merge && npm run report:generate
scripts.test:chrome: npm run clean:reports && cypress run --browser chrome; npm run report:merge && npm run report:generate
scripts.test:firefox: npm run clean:reports && cypress run --browser firefox; npm run report:merge && npm run report:generate
scripts.test:edge: npm run clean:reports && cypress run --browser edge; npm run report:merge && npm run report:generate
scripts.test:all-browsers: npm run test:chrome && npm run test:firefox && npm run test:edge
